settings.text: 45 000+ dog owners are keeping eyes clean without the struggle

Eyewipes are designed with the sensitive eyes of dogs and cats in mind.

settings.heading: How soon will I see results?
settings.row_content: Most dog parents notice brighter, cleaner eyes within 7–10 days of daily use. For deeper, long-standing stains, expect 2–3 weeks for full improvement. Consistency is key - the routine works best when done daily.

settings.heading: Is it safe for my dog's eyes?
settings.row_content: Yes, absolutely. VetPets EyeWipes are ophthalmologist-tested and formulated specifically for the delicate eye area. The pH-balanced, hypoallergenic formula contains soothing ingredients like Aloe Vera and Chamomile. They're gentle enough for daily use, even on puppies and dogs with sensitive eyes.

settings.heading: Will this help old, stubborn tear stains?
settings.row_content: Yes. While fresh stains respond quickly (7–10 days), stubborn tear stains that have built up over months may take 2–3 weeks of consistent daily use to fade significantly. The key is removing the bacteria causing new staining while the old discoloration gradually lightens. Patience and daily use make the difference.

settings.heading: How often should I use it?
settings.row_content: Once daily is ideal for most dogs. Use one wipe per eye, gently cleaning from the inner corner outward. For dogs prone to heavy discharge or during allergy season, you can use them twice daily (morning and evening). Consistency matters more than frequency.

settings.heading: How long does one container last?
settings.row_content: Each container has 100 wipes. For daily use (one wipe per eye), one container lasts approximately 6–7 weeks for one dog. Most customers choose the Value Pack (4 months for one dog) or Family Pack (6 months for one dog). Have multiple dogs? The Family Pack is our most popular choice.

settings.heading: Will the stains come back?
settings.row_content: Tear staining is caused by bacteria and moisture buildup, which is ongoing for many dogs. The stains won't return as long as you maintain the daily routine. If you stop using the wipes, bacteria can accumulate again and stains may gradually reappear. Think of it like brushing teeth - consistency prevents problems from coming back.

settings.heading: What's the difference between these and baby wipes?
settings.row_content: Baby wipes often contain fragrances, lotions, and harsh preservatives that can irritate the sensitive eye area. VetPets EyeWipes are specifically formulated for dogs' eyes - hypoallergenic, fragrance-free, pH-balanced, and contain antibacterial ingredients that actually prevent regrowth. They don't just wipe the surface; they address the root cause.

settings.heading: Can I use these on cats too?
settings.row_content: Yes! VetPets EyeWipes are safe for both dogs and cats. Cats can also develop tear staining and eye discharge, especially flat-faced breeds like Persians. Use the same technique - one wipe per eye, gently cleaning from inner corner outward.

settings.heading: My dog hates having their eyes touched. Will this work?
settings.row_content: Many dogs are initially hesitant. Start slowly - let them sniff the wipe first, offer treats, and keep sessions short (30 seconds max). Most dogs adjust within a few days once they realize it's quick and gentle. Some customers find it easier right after walks when dogs are calmer, or during cuddle time on the couch.

settings.heading: Do I need to rinse after using?
settings.row_content: No rinsing needed. The wipes are designed to be used and discarded. Just gently wipe the eye area, discard the wipe, and you're done. The formula is safe to leave on and will continue working to prevent bacterial regrowth.
